about:
Elite Medical Care was founded in 2016 in Mabelvale, Arkansas, as a family-owned, full-service durable medical equipment provider. The company began with a focus on respiratory therapy and has expanded to serve all of Arkansas and roughly half of Mississippi.

The company supplies a range of respiratory and mobility equipment, including invasive and noninvasive ventilators, Philips Trilogy machines for COPD, oxygen systems, CPAP and BiPAP devices, tracheostomy supplies, hospital beds, and wheelchairs. Its staff includes licensed respiratory therapists who handle equipment setup, patient education, and ongoing clinical support. Operations emphasize rapid deployment, with same-day delivery available for urgent needs.

Elite Medical Care serves home-healthcare patients, long-term-care facilities, and hospice providers. Nursing centers and hospice organizations in Arkansas and Mississippi rely on the company for timely equipment delivery and clinical coordination; testimonials cite partnerships with a local nursing center, a hospice administrator, and a community health provider.

The business distinguishes itself through its family-owned structure, ACHC accreditation, state pharmacy-board licenses, and a locally rooted team that undergoes continuous training on evolving respiratory technology. The founders aimed to combine equipment supply with hands-on, compassionate support so patients can recover at home.
